title: MathGenie: Generating Synthetic Data with Question Back-translation for Enhancing Mathematical Reasoning of LLMs
authors_zh: Zimu Lu、Aojun Zhou、Houxing Ren、Ke Wang、Weikang Shi、Junting Pan、Mingjie Zhan、Hongsheng Li
paper_type_zh: 解答回译数学数据集与验证筛选研究
best_for_zh: 适合从解答合成数学题，或审计代码集成示范和模型生成的验证推理。
one_line: MathGenieData combines 81K code-integrated solutions, 30K verification rationales, and 170K back-translated math pairs in typed execution-aware records.
MathGenieData 汇集 81K 代码解答、30K 验证推理和 170K 解答回译题目，并保留文本、代码与执行结果。
why: It makes solution-first question synthesis and rationale-bearing quality filtering independently inspectable in an openly readable math corpus.
inclusion_reason: MathGenie releases reusable problem-solution and verification-rationale demonstrations and directly tests solution-first back-translation, iterative augmentation, filtering, and scale.

title: Problem
问题
html:
MathGenie asks how to scale mathematical question-solution data without paying GPT-4 to directly invent every problem, while keeping new questions constrained and their code-integrated solutions reliable. The primary source is an ACL 2024 main-conference long paper, and the decision boundary is its released static MathGenieData rather than verified inference as an online algorithm alone.

The relevant data object combines seed code-integrated solutions, code-integrated verification rationales, and new question-solution pairs produced by iteratively augmenting solutions before translating them back into questions. Answer consistency and model-written executable verification decide retention, while diverse 7B-70B consumers are evaluated on two in-domain and three out-of-domain math sets; the typed demonstrations fit instruction, rationale, and process-supervision data.

L4 facts: official ACL 2024 main paper, DOI 10.18653/v1/2024.acl-long.151; official non-gated Apache-2.0 MathGenie/MathGenieData; about 281K records in one 810MB JSONL, with multiple anonymous actual rows read; nested system/user/assistant messages and typed text/code/execution content, construction, filtering, consumers, ablations, impact, execution risks, and license lineage verified.

MathGenie 研究如何在不让 GPT-4 直接创造每一道题的情况下扩展数学题解数据，同时约束新题并提高代码集成解答的可靠性。主来源是 ACL 2024 主会长文，本卡判定对象是公开的静态 MathGenieData，而不是单独作为在线算法的验证推理。

数据对象同时包含种子代码解答、代码集成验证推理，以及先迭代增强解答再回译为题目的新题解对。答案一致性和模型生成的可执行验证决定是否保留，多种七十亿至七百亿参数消费者在两个域内和三个域外数学集合上评估，因此这些带类型示范属于指令、推理与过程监督数据。

L4 事实：正式来源为 ACL 2024 主会，编号 10.18653/v1/2024.acl-long.151；官方数据无需申请、采用 Apache-2.0；单个 810MB 文件约有 281K 条记录，已匿名读取多条真实样本；嵌套消息与文本、代码、执行内容，以及构造、筛选、消费者、消融、影响力、执行风险和许可血缘均已核对。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
MathGenie reverses the usual augmentation direction: instead of directly perturbing a question and hoping it remains solvable, it iteratively changes a known solution and trains a model to back-translate the constrained solution into a matching question. A separately trained solver-verifier then writes code-integrated solutions and executable verification rationales, and only accepted pairs join the release; the auditable target is therefore both a solving demonstration and an explicit model judgment trace.

Google Scholar citations: 116（checked 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=MathGenie%3A+Generating+Synthetic+Data+with+Question+Back-translation+for+Enhancing+Mathematical+Reasoning+of+LLMs&author=Zimu+Lu&hl=en）

Open dataset: yes. Dataset name: MathGenieData. Official URL: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MathGenie/MathGenieData. Scale: 81K GPT-4 code-integrated solutions, 30K GPT-4 verification rationales, and 170K augmented pairs, totaling about 281K records. Record form: nested system, user, and assistant messages; each message has a content list whose items use type: text, type: code, or type: execution. File / storage format: one 810,337,193-byte public JSONL file, data/mathgenie_train.jsonl. Domains / languages: English grade-school and competition mathematics, natural-language reasoning, Python, and recorded execution feedback. Construction and filtering: augment solutions iteratively, back-translate solutions to questions, generate code-integrated answers, reject answer disagreement, then retain verifier-approved pairs. License / access constraints: non-gated Apache-2.0 dataset and code; source benchmarks, instruction corpora, GPT-4 outputs, and base-model terms still require review. Intended use: math SFT, code-integrated reasoning, verification-rationale training, data synthesis, filtering ablations, and execution-aware audits.

MathGenie 反转常见增强方向：它不直接扰动问题并寄望新题仍可解，而是迭代改变已知解答，再训练模型把受约束解答回译成匹配题目。另一个求解与验证模型生成代码集成解答和可执行验证推理，只有被接受的题解对进入发布。因此可审计目标同时包含求解示范和显式模型判断轨迹。

Google Scholar 引用数：116（查询于 2026-07-27；https://scholar.google.com/scholar_lookup?title=MathGenie%3A+Generating+Synthetic+Data+with+Question+Back-translation+for+Enhancing+Mathematical+Reasoning+of+LLMs&author=Zimu+Lu&hl=en）

开放状态：公开且无需申请。数据集名称为 MathGenieData。官方地址见元数据。规模：八万一千条代码集成解答、三万条验证推理和十七万条增强题解，总计约二十八万一千条。记录使用系统、用户和助手嵌套消息，内容项分为文本、代码和执行。存储为一个约八百一十兆字节的公开文件。领域包括英文数学、自然语言推理、Python 和执行反馈。构造包括迭代增强解答、回译题目、生成代码解答、拒绝答案不一致和验证筛选。数据与代码采用 Apache-2.0，但来源、教师输出和基础模型条款仍需审核。适用于数学监督微调、代码推理、验证推理训练、合成与执行审计。

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1: Input: 15K human-annotated GSM8K and MATH question-solution pairs, plus 81K GPT-4 Code Interpreter solutions and 30K verification rationales in the release. Operation: Train Llama-2-70B-derived models for solution augmentation, solution-to-question back-translation, code-integrated solving, and verification. Output and transition: Specialized Mtext, Mbacktrans, and Mcode models provide the synthesis and filtering substrate. Check / stop rule: Pin every seed revision, GPT-4 record, typed serializer, base checkpoint, prompt, and executable environment before regeneration.

Step 2: Input: Human-written seed solutions and prompts that replace objects or verbs, add a reasoning step, change numbers, or replace numbers and variables. Operation: Apply the solution augmenter repeatedly, using each round's outputs as the next round's inputs and taking the union of all generated rounds. Output and transition: Diverse augmented solutions remain constrained by explicit calculations and logical relations. Check / stop rule: Preserve seed identity, transformation prompt, round, model revision, and duplicates; the released minimal schema does not expose these fields.

Step 3: Input: Augmented solutions and a Llama-2-70B model trained on reversed solution-question seed pairs. Operation: Back-translate each solution into a question whose conditions and requested quantity match the given derivation. Output and transition: New GSM8K-like and MATH-like questions enter code-integrated solution generation. Check / stop rule: Reject malformed question text and independently solve samples; solution constraints improve but do not guarantee semantic validity.

Step 4: Input: New questions and Mcode, trained from GPT-4 code-integrated solutions and verification rationales. Operation: Generate candidate solutions that interleave text, Python, execution output, and final answers; first compare their extracted answers. Output and transition: Answer-consistent question-solution candidates enter rationale-based verification. Check / stop rule: Remove a question when candidate solutions reach different answers; agreement can still preserve a shared error.

Step 5: Input: Each surviving question-solution pair and the same verification-capable Mcode. Operation: Generate a code-integrated verification rationale and classify the proposed solution as correct or wrong. Output and transition: Retain 110K GSM8K-derived and 60K MATH-derived augmented pairs, then combine them with 81K seed solutions and 30K verification rationales. Check / stop rule: Discard verifier-rejected pairs, but independently audit false positives because average verification precision is 82.6% and MATH precision is 64.5%.

Step 6: Input: MathGenieData and pretrained consumers from 7B to 70B. Operation: Full-fine-tune with AdamW and evaluate greedy decoding on GSM8K, MATH, SVAMP, Simuleq, and Mathematics. Output and transition: Controlled composition, scale, iteration, filtering, and augmentation-method comparisons quantify the data recipe. Check / stop rule: Hold base model, examples, tokens, execution policy, and evaluation scripts fixed; sandbox every replay and report verifier calls separately.

步骤一： 输入：一万五千条人工题解，以及发布中的代码集成解答和验证推理。 操作：训练解答增强、解答到题目回译、代码求解和验证所需的七百亿参数专用模型。 输出与流转：多个专用模型共同构成合成和筛选底座。 检查与停止：重新生成前固定全部种子、教师记录、类型序列化、基础模型、提示和执行环境。

步骤二： 输入：人工种子解答以及替换对象、增加步骤、改变数字等提示。 操作：迭代增强解答，每一轮使用前一轮输出，并合并全部轮次。 输出与流转：多样化解答仍受显式计算和逻辑关系约束。 检查与停止：保留来源、变换提示、轮次、模型版本与重复信息；公开精简字段没有这些血缘。

步骤三： 输入：增强解答和用反向题解对训练的回译模型。 操作：把每份解答翻译成条件和目标都与推导匹配的新问题。 输出与流转：新小学题和竞赛题进入代码集成求解。 检查与停止：拒绝格式异常题目并独立求解抽样；解答约束提高可靠性，但不能保证语义有效。

步骤四： 输入：新题和具备求解、验证能力的模型。 操作：生成交错文本、代码、执行结果与最终答案的候选解答，并先比较提取答案。 输出与流转：答案一致的候选进入推理验证。 检查与停止：候选答案不一致时删除整道题；一致也可能保留共同错误。

步骤五： 输入：每个候选题解对和验证模型。 操作：生成代码集成验证推理，并判断解答正确或错误。 输出与流转：保留十一万条小学题派生对和六万条竞赛题派生对，再与种子解答和验证推理合并。 检查与停止：删除验证拒绝项，但仍须独立审计假阳性，因为平均精确率为 82.6%，MATH 上仅 64.5%。

步骤六： 输入：完整数据和多种规模的预训练消费者。 操作：完整微调并在五个数学集合上进行贪心解码评测。 输出与流转：组合、规模、迭代、筛选和增强方法对照衡量数据配方。 检查与停止：固定基础模型、样本数、词元、执行策略和评测脚本；沙箱重放代码并单独报告验证调用。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
End-to-end breadth. MathGenieLM-InternLM2-20B reaches 87.7 on GSM8K, 55.7 on MATH, 87.3 on SVAMP, 88.5 on Simuleq, and 85.1 on Mathematics, averaging 80.9 under greedy decoding. With Llama-2-70B, MathGenie averages 78.5 versus 72.5 for ToRA on the same backbone; the complete recipes still differ in data and training, so this supports the released pipeline rather than a single filtering step.

Controlled synthesis and filtering. On Mistral-7B, Seed plus verification data averages 65.9 across five sets, while adding all 170K AugData reaches 72.0 and increasing AugData from one-eighth to full raises the average from 68.2 to 72.0. Verification filtering raises GSM8K/MATH from 79.3/43.8 to 80.5/45.1, and iterative augmentation averages 72.0 versus 70.7 without iteration. These comparisons support scale, iteration, and filtering, while the verifier's imperfect precision limits label trust.

端到端广度。MathGenieLM-InternLM2-20B 在 GSM8K、MATH、SVAMP、Simuleq 和 Mathematics 上分别得到 87.7、55.7、87.3、88.5 和 85.1，贪心解码平均为 80.9。使用相同 Llama-2-70B 底座时，MathGenie 平均 78.5，ToRA 为 72.5；两者数据和训练仍不同，因此结果支持完整发布流程，不能只归因于单个筛选步骤。

受控合成与筛选。在 Mistral-7B 上，种子加验证数据的五集合平均为 65.9，加入全部十七万条增强数据后达到 72.0；增强数据从八分之一扩到全部时，平均从 68.2 增至 72.0。验证筛选把 GSM8K 和 MATH 从 79.3、43.8 提升到 80.5、45.1，迭代增强平均为 72.0，不迭代为 70.7。这些对照支持规模、迭代与筛选，但验证器精确率不完美，限制了标签可信度。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior math synthesis often perturbed questions directly, which can break hidden constraints, or used expensive closed teachers for every new item. MathGenie changes the reusable object by augmenting a known solution first, back-translating its explicit constraints into a question, and packaging both executable solving traces and executable verification rationales. Back-translation, self-consistency, code execution, and SFT are not individually new; the direction signal is their staged composition plus direct iteration, scale, augmentation, and filter ablations. The verifier traces are valuable audit material precisely because they are explicit but not perfectly reliable.
以往数学合成常直接扰动题目，容易破坏隐藏约束，或为每条新数据调用昂贵闭源教师。MathGenie 改变了可复用对象：先增强已知解答，再把其中显式约束回译为问题，并同时打包可执行求解轨迹和可执行验证推理。回译、自洽性、代码执行和监督微调本身都不是新方法；方向信号来自分阶段组合，以及对迭代、规模、增强方式和过滤的直接消融。验证轨迹之所以值得审计，正因为它们显式可见但并非完全可靠。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Mcode verifies its own style of solutions and has only 82.6% average precision, including 64.5% on MATH. Replay code and use independent solvers or human review before treating accepted pairs as positives.
  • The pipeline full-fine-tunes several 70B models and reports up to 32 A800 80GB GPUs; teacher cost, retries, and per-record provenance are not consolidated, limiting exact reproduction.
  • Records contain executable Python, models are limited to text and 4,096-token contexts, and no broad semantic decontamination is reported. Sandbox code, scan target evaluations, and retain upstream rights metadata.

• 验证模型检查与自身风格相近的解答，平均精确率只有 82.6%，在 MATH 上为 64.5%。把接受项当作正例前，应重放代码并用独立求解器或人工审核。
  • 流程完整微调多个七百亿参数模型，最高使用三十二张 A800 80GB；教师成本、重试和逐条血缘没有统一报告，限制精确复现。
  • 记录含可执行 Python，模型只处理文本且上下文为 4096，也未报告广泛语义去污染。应沙箱执行、扫描目标评测并保留上游权利信息。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use MathGenieData when a math consumer should learn to alternate explanation, Python, execution feedback, and final answers, or when a separate verifier should learn explicit checking rationales. Preserve typed content order, replay every execution in a pinned sandbox, separate seed solutions, verification records, and augmented pairs, and evaluate unfiltered versus filtered data with an independent checker. Do not use verifier acceptance as ground truth or deploy raw code without isolation; add source IDs, augmentation rounds, model revisions, and decision metadata before large-scale reuse.
当数学模型需要学习解释、Python、执行反馈和最终答案的交替，或独立验证器需要学习显式检查推理时，可以使用 MathGenieData。应保留类型内容顺序，在固定沙箱中重放每段执行，分开种子解答、验证记录和增强题解，并用独立检查器比较筛选前后数据。不要把验证接受当作真值，也不要在无隔离环境执行原始代码；大规模复用前补充来源编号、增强轮次、模型版本和判决元数据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. The release combines 81K code-integrated seed solutions, 30K verification rationales, and 170K augmented pairs.
  2. Solution-first augmentation preserves explicit constraints before a 70B model back-translates each derivation into a new question.
  3. Actual JSONL records use nested messages and typed text, code, and execution items in assistant order.
  4. Full AugData raises the Mistral-7B five-set average from 65.9 to 72.0; verification filtering adds 1.2 points on the GSM8K/MATH mean.
  5. Reuse requires independent correctness checks, execution sandboxing, decontamination, and reconstructed per-record provenance.

1. 发布合并 81K 条代码种子解答、30K 条验证推理和 170K 条增强题解对。
  2. 解答优先增强先保留显式约束，再由七百亿参数模型把推导回译成新题。
  3. 真实文件使用嵌套消息，助手内容按顺序包含文本、代码和执行项。
  4. 全部增强数据把 Mistral-7B 的五集合平均从 65.9 提升到 72.0，验证筛选使两个主基准均值增加 1.2 分。
  5. 复用需要独立正确性检查、执行沙箱、去污染和逐条血缘重建。

value.html: Several specialized 70B-model passes per augmented item, plus code execution and a verification-rationale pass; the paper does not consolidate total generation cost.

value.html: AdamW full-parameter SFT, batch 64, cosine schedule, 50 warmup steps, context length 4,096; up to 32 A800 80GB GPUs for 34B and 70B consumers.

value.html: Official release: 81K GPT-4 code-integrated solutions, 30K GPT-4 code-integrated verification rationales, and 170K pipeline-augmented pairs, for about 281K records; AugData is 110K GSM8K-derived plus 60K MATH-derived.

value.html: The paper uses GSM8K and MATH train data and tests on their held-out sets plus three external sets, but reports no broad semantic overlap scan for back-translated questions.

items: The verifier's average precision is 82.6%, and MATH precision is 64.5%, so false-positive solutions remain possible.
Executable Python and recorded outputs require sandboxing and replay before reuse.
The public minimal messages schema does not expose source ID, augmentation round, generator revision, or verification score per record.
验证器平均精确率为 82.6%，MATH 精确率为 64.5%，因此假阳性解答仍可能。
可执行 Python 与记录的输出在复用前需要沙箱化与回放。
公开的最小 messages schema 不暴露来源 ID、增强轮次、生成器修订或逐记录验证分数。

value.html: Apache-2.0 on the official dataset and code repositories; GSM8K, MATH, OpenOrca, Alpaca-GPT4, GPT-4 outputs, and base-model terms still require lineage-aware review.
